name: Drowning High Five
look: A four-panel comic in a 2x2 grid. A hand pokes up out of blue water reaching for help, another hand reaches down toward it, the two hands meet in a loud high five against a pink background, and in the last panel the first hand sinks below the surface in bubbles.
use: Someone in trouble reaches out for help and gets a cheerful gesture instead of a rescue. The drowning hand is the person in need, and the high-fiving hand is whoever answers with useless encouragement or misreads the situation.
slots: label on the drowning hand (who needs help)
label on the high-fiving hand (the useless response)
examples: Me asking the group chat for help moving apartments
Me telling the teacher I don't understand the assignment
describe: drowning hand gets a high five instead of being saved
comic of a hand in the water and someone high fives it
person reaches out of the ocean, gets a high five, then sinks
four panel comic with a hand sinking after a high five
asking for help and getting a high five while going under
origin: A comic by the artist Anton Gudim, who signs his work "Gudim".
